name: bpe5k
description: The 5227 lowest-numbered tokens of GPT-2's BPE vocabulary: single bytes plus the word pieces BPE merged first, which are the most frequent ones. A real subword vocabulary, so it can spell anything by falling back to shorter pieces. Too large for one Jev question: use --strategy buckets.

stop.description: The reply is already complete and well formed: stop writing.
